comment: The Taj Mahal is even more breathtaking in person. Go early morning to beat the crowds!
Stunning monument, but it gets very crowded by mid-morning. Plan accordingly.
Jaipur's forts and bazaars are a photographer's dream. Loved every bit of it.
Great beaches and nightlife. Baga was a bit touristy, but still fun.
Perfect relaxing getaway with amazing seafood by the beach.
The houseboat stay on the backwaters was one of the most peaceful experiences ever.
Udaipur is magical at sunset. The lake views from the palace are unforgettable.
Visiting the Golden Temple was a deeply moving experience. Very well maintained.
